_comment: Shop commissions (CommissionManager.gd). Each shop keeps one open request: bring qty of a material by the due day. Delivering pays gold (material value x reward_per_value, at least min_reward) and raises your standing with that shop. Standing tiers give the shop's perks: Blacksmith and Enchanter take discount off their gold cost and add success; the Alchemist teaches recipes (recipes.json unlock type standing).

blacksmith.name: Blacksmith
blacksmith.line: "My forge is hungry. Bring me {qty} {item} by day {due}."

alchemist.name: Alchemist
alchemist.line: "I'm short on {item} - {qty} of them, by day {due}, if you'd be so kind."
